description_en: Modifies or disables the committed Serverless feature
description_zh: 调用该接口，修改或关闭承诺型Serverless功能
name: ModifyComputeBurstConfig

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求之间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The time at which the modification takes effect. Valid values:
0: The modification takes effect immediately.
1: The modification takes effect during the maintenance window. You can call the ModifyDBInstanceMaintainTime operation to modify the maintenance window.
2: The modification takes effect at a specified point in time
parameters.help_zh:
生效策略。取值如下：
0：立即生效。
1：在可运维时间段内生效，可调用ModifyDBInstanceMaintainTime接口修改可运维时间段。
2：指定时间点生效
parameters.name: switch_time_mode

parameters.help_en:
The point in time at which the modification takes effect. Format: `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` (UTC).
This parameter is required when SwitchTimeMode is set to 2
parameters.help_zh:
指定生效的时间。格式：`yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）
SwitchTimeMode取值为2时，需要配置该参数
parameters.name: switch_time

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of CPUs for elastic scale-out. The value can be up to twice the initial CPU configuration of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 弹性扩容的CPU上限。最多为实例初始 CPU 配置的两倍
parameters.name: scale_max_cpus

parameters.help_en: The maximum memory for elastic scale-out. The value can be up to twice the initial memory configuration of the instance. Unit: GB. The value is adjusted in increments of 2 GB
parameters.help_zh: 弹性扩容的内存上限。最多为实例初始内存配置的两倍。单位：GB，每次调整量为 2 GB
parameters.name: scale_max_memory

parameters.help_en: RDS MySQL 承诺型 Serverless RCU 扩缩容上界
parameters.help_zh: RDS MySQL 承诺型 Serverless RCU 扩缩容上界
parameters.name: scale_max_rcu

parameters.help_en: RDS MySQL 承诺型 Serverless RCU 扩缩容下界
parameters.help_zh: RDS MySQL 承诺型 Serverless RCU 扩缩容下界
parameters.name: scale_min_rcu

parameters.help_en: The CPU utilization threshold for elastic scale-in. Valid values: 30 to 55. Unit: %
parameters.help_zh: 弹性缩容的 CPU 使用率阈值。取值范围：30~55，单位：%
parameters.name: cpu_shrink_threshold

parameters.help_en: The CPU utilization threshold for elastic scale-out. Valid values: 60 to 90. Unit: %
parameters.help_zh: 弹性扩容的 CPU 使用率阈值。取值范围：60~90，单位：%
parameters.name: cpu_enlarge_threshold

parameters.help_en: The memory utilization threshold for elastic scale-in. Valid values: 30 to 55. Unit: %
parameters.help_zh: 弹性缩容的内存使用率阈值。取值范围：30~55，单位：%
parameters.name: memory_shrink_threshold

parameters.help_en: The memory utilization threshold for elastic scale-out. Valid values: 60 to 90. Unit: %
parameters.help_zh: 弹性扩容的内存使用率阈值。取值范围：60~90，单位：%
parameters.name: memory_enlarge_threshold

parameters.help_en: Set this parameter to disabled to disable the committed Serverless feature
parameters.help_zh: 关闭承诺型 Serverless 功能时，该参数传入disabled
parameters.name: burst_status

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter. This parameter is not supported
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: A reserved parameter. This parameter is not supported
parameters.name: crontab_job_id
